blocks.text: Color Tips that Make Your Space Pop!

The right color doesn’t just decorate, it communicates. Whether you’re adding personal flair to a cozy home or establishing your brand identity in a business setting, your color choices can completely transform the experience of a space.

That’s why so many property owners across the South Sound from Tacoma and Gig Harbor to Puyallup and Bonney Lake trust Black Pearl Painters for both professional painting and color consultation services. Our expert team helps clients select the perfect color palette, determine the right finish, and ensure a smooth, high-quality application using premium Sherwin-Williams paints.
From single-family homes to town homes, condos, and commercial buildings, here are our pro-level color tips to make sure your paint choices truly shine.

blocks.text: Expert Tips for Homeowners (Including Condos & Townhomes)
Tip #1: Test Samples on Multiple Walls with Different Lighting

Color tips: Lighting plays a major role in how paint colors are perceived. In the Pacific Northwest, where overcast days are common, it’s especially important to test colors in different rooms, on different walls, and at various times of day.

Whether you’re repainting your townhome in Bonney Lake, giving your Tacoma condo a refresh, or updating your family home in Gig Harbor, don’t rely on a tiny swatch. Apply generous samples using actual Sherwin-Williams paint and observe them under both natural and artificial lighting.

Why hire Black Pearl Painters? We take the guesswork out of color testing by guiding you through the process with real samples, expert lighting advice, and our trained eye for undertones that might otherwise clash with your furniture or finishes.
Tip #2: Neutrals Can Be Bold When Paired with Texture

Color tips: Neutrals are often misunderstood as boring, but when paired with natural textures or bold trim, they create depth and sophistication. Picture Sherwin-Williams’ Shoji White on the walls with matte black metal accents, or Accessible Beige paired with natural wood tones in a cozy condo or craftsman-style townhome.
Whether you’re working within an COA/TOA/HOA-approved palette or want a clean, modern backdrop that allows art and furnishings to pop, neutrals can bring your space to life.

Why hire Black Pearl? Our team knows how to pair colors with materials, surfaces, and existing finishes. We don’t just paint, we help you build a balanced, designer-quality look that elevates your entire space.
Tip #3: Consider Resale Value When Choosing Exteriors

If resale is on your radar, color choice becomes even more strategic. For condos, townhomes, and single-family homes, the right palette can significantly improve curb appeal and attract potential buyers.

Color tips: Soft greens, deep grays, and stormy blues, colors like Dorian Gray, Green Earth, or Slate Tile are consistently popular in the South Sound. Trim colors like Tricorn Black or Alabaster add crisp contrast that appeals to modern buyers.

Why hire Black Pearl? We not only understand real estate trends we work with homeowners, landlords, and COA/TOA/HOAs to select market-savvy color combinations that enhance property value while remaining timeless and tasteful.

blocks.text: Expert Tips for Business Owners
Tip #4: Use Brand-Aligned Colors in Lobbies and Signage
A well-chosen color scheme can help your brand stand out and build trust. Your lobby, reception area, and building exterior should all communicate your business’s values and personality.
Whether you’re a startup, retail shop, or established professional office, Black Pearl Painters can help you find or match Sherwin-Williams colors that reflect your brand and apply them flawlessly.
Why hire Black Pearl? We offer custom color matching, large-scale commercial painting, and detailed prep work that ensures your branding is always sharp, clean, and cohesive.
Tip #5: Stick with Calming Colors in Offices and Healthcare Spaces

Color tips: In spaces where focus, calm, and clarity are essential, such as medical offices, therapy rooms, and open workspaces, cool, soft tones like Sea Salt, Silver Strand, or Agreeable Gray create a soothing environment that promotes concentration and comfort.

Why hire Black Pearl? We’ve worked with dozens of offices across Tacoma and Puyallup, choosing colors based on the psychology of color and applying them with zero disruption to your business schedule.
Tip #6: Go Bold in Retail—Draw the Eye, Create Energy

In retail environments, color is your secret weapon. Bold shades like Rave Red, Cavern Clay, or Naval can direct attention, energize customers, and influence buying behavior. Color tips: Accent walls, color blocking, and curated palettes help create Instagram-worthy interiors that customers remember.

Why hire Black Pearl? We bring both design insight and technical know-how to your retail space. Our team ensures each color is placed with intention and we handle all prep, repairs, and application with care, so your store looks polished and professional.
Tips for Both Homes and Businesses
Tip #7: Don’t Forget About Finishes—Matte vs. Satin vs. Gloss

The right finish is just as important as the right color. Matte finishes hide imperfections and look elegant in low-traffic areas. Satin and eggshell finishes are ideal for general living spaces or business lobbies, offering durability with a soft sheen. Gloss and semi-gloss work well on trim, doors, and high-touch surfaces.

Why hire Black Pearl? Our experts guide you through selecting the best Sherwin-Williams paint formulation and finish for every surface, walls, ceilings, cabinets, and beyond. We take durability, cleanability, and lighting into account for every recommendation.
Tip #8: Always View Colors in Natural and Artificial Light
Lighting shifts throughout the day and can dramatically change the appearance of paint colors. This is particularly true in the Pacific Northwest, where diffused daylight can dull colors indoors.
Before finalizing your choices for a condo hallway, townhome kitchen, or commercial lobby, test them under LED, incandescent, and natural light to avoid unexpected surprises.

Why hire Black Pearl? We help you see beyond the swatch literally. We’ll provide on-site sampling and expert analysis so you don’t waste time or money repainting a wall that didn’t turn out how you imagined.
